summary_1line: Ravana boasts of his power and wealth, describing Lanka and urging Sita to abandon Rama and live with him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana, scowling and regal, stands before Sita in the forest boasting of his might while she listens with defiant calm.
Ravana gestures proudly as he describes the golden ramparts and emerald gates of Lanka rising beyond the sea.
